summary: Investor-ready student venture competition; the 2–5 page executive summary leads to the Houston finals.
eligibility: Worldwide, cross-university student ventures with university adviser endorsement and student management and equity. The guide allows undergraduate teams but the FAQ requires a graduate member; resolve before applying.
title: Rice Business Plan Competition 2027

prize.description: 2027 prize allocation unspecified; cash, investment and prizes are marketed together and are not all cash.

notes: Applications open 9 November. Houston competition 8–10 April 2027. Fee and travel support unspecified.
